title: fix(studio): a flow just created in Studio reads 已停用 in its header, and the create toast says it is switched off
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8UM6sVtCKnoTEvHVeZGcCcL)_

Fixes #36742

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 管理员在 Studio 的「自动化」里新建一个流程后，页头状态立刻显示「已停用」，不再误显示「未发布草稿」；提示从「已保存并生效」改成「已创建：名称（已停用，启用后才会运行）」。「数据」页的空状态也不再说「最后一次发布」。
- 属于 Studio 评审那批问题之一：新建的流程其实已经发布、只是默认关着，旧的页头和提示说法互相矛盾，作者不知道该不该再点发布。
- 出错的话只是新建后页头状态或提示文字不对，流程本身怎么保存、发布、开关都没变，可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

Paths are under `ui/packages/`.

1. **The header reads the engine after a create.** `doCreateFlow` (`app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`) writes the new flow's draft and publishes it at once, born switched off (`status: 'obsolete'`). The header's Status pill derives from the `/api/v1/automation/_status` snapshot, which is read again only when `publishNonce` or `statusNonce` changes. Save and the on/off switch bump `statusNonce` after their publish; the create did not, so the snapshot taken before the flow existed had no row for it, and `deriveFlowRunStatus(null)` reads a missing row as `unpublished` (「未发布草稿」). The create now bumps `statusNonce` after its publish, so the engine's row for the switched-off flow is read and the pill says 「已停用」 (`kind: 'off'`).
2. **The create toast has its own key.** It reused `engine.studio.save.done` (「已保存并生效：{items}」), which promises a run the new flow will not do. New key `engine.studio.auto.createdOff` in the studio namespace: zh 「已创建：{name}（已停用，启用后才会运行）」, en "Created: {name} (switched off; it runs once you switch it on)". The namespace has two tables (en, zh); both carry it.
3. **Two texts the review found wrong whatever the save model is:**
   - `engine.studio.data.firstObjectHint` no longer ends 「…最后一次发布。」 / "publish once at the end": objects are live on Save, and it now says each Save takes effect at once.
   - The comment over the Changes/Publish buttons no longer says only the copilot leaves drafts: the Interfaces pillar and the Metadata area still do.

Changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n` patch. No new export, route or spec key.

## Tests

New `app-shell/src/views/studio-design/AutomationsPillar.newFlowStatus-36742.test.tsx`: the real `AutomationsPillar` with the real `FlowPreview`/`FlowInspector`, over a metadata client double whose publish moves the draft to the live row, and an `/automation/_status` double that answers from the live rows (a published flow has a row, switched off when `obsolete`; a flow that does not exist has none).

- After creating "Escalate": the write log is `save` then `publish`, the flow is born `obsolete`, the header Status pill reads "Switched off" and not "Unpublished draft", and `_status` was read more than once.
- The create toast is `engine.studio.auto.createdOff` with `{ name }`, not `engine.studio.save.done`; the en row and the zh catalogue row are pinned as the card asks.

Ablation, with the fix committed (`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored with `git diff HEAD` empty): removing the `setStatusNonce` bump in `doCreateFlow` turns the header test red (`Expected: "Switched off"`, `Received: "Unpublished draft"`); restored, 2/2.

## Acceptance notes

- The header pill follows the engine's row. On a deployment whose `_status` route is absent (an older backend), the pill keeps its pre-read reading from the draft's `status`, which for a new flow is 「已停用」 too.
- The Interfaces pillar's inspector footer 「编辑在点击顶栏「保存」后生效。」 is also untrue there (it autosaves a draft). The review left it to the Interfaces save-model card, which Warren ruled not to do until that column is retired; not touched here.

## Verification

Read first:
1. `doCreateFlow` in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`: the `setStatusNonce` bump after `publishSavedItem`, and the toast key below it.
2. The two rows in `i18n/src/namespaces/studio/{zh,en}.ts`.

Browser, showcase on this branch (`objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`) behind this branch's Console (Vite, `DEV_PROXY_TARGET`), zh-CN. Studio → 功能展示 (定制) → 自动化 → 新建自动化 → 手动 → 「创建」; the flow lands in the showcase's customization package, published and switched off.

- This branch: the toast reads 「已创建：报销单超时提醒（已停用，启用后才会运行）」; the header reads 「触发: 自动启动 · 状态: 已停用 · 运行身份: 用户」, pill title 「已停用 — 不会运行」. `/automation/_status` was read once more after the create (2 reads at mount, 3 after).
- Before, the same steps with `origin/main`'s `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` and studio tables swapped into the same Console (then restored, `git diff HEAD` empty): toast 「已保存并生效：采购单超时提醒」; header 「状态: 未发布草稿」 in amber, title 「尚未部署 — 发布后才会部署」; no `_status` read after the create.

Screenshots are attached in the project thread (GitHub's image store takes browser uploads only): before and after of the header, before and after of the toast.

The Data pillar's first-object hint is checked in the string tables only; reaching that empty state needs a package with no objects, which this stack does not offer without a new app.

Two-minute check: in Studio → 自动化, create a flow with 「创建」: the header reads 「状态: 已停用」 and the toast reads 「已创建：名称（已停用，启用后才会运行）」.
